allowedSourceMaterial.overview: Giulia De Martino is a pilot. At seventeen she participates in the GT Championship, under the guidance of her father Mario. But one day everything changes and Giulia has to face alone both the track and her own life.

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: Left without her father's guidance, can Giulia survive the unrelenting pressure of the GT track all on her own?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: At seventeen, Giulia De Martino competes in the GT Championship guided by her father Mario. When sudden upheaval changes everything, she is forced to navigate the high-stakes circuit and her personal life entirely alone.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Fast-paced, emotionally intense racing drama demanding engaged attention for a solo, high-stakes ride.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Matteo Rovere drives this high-velocity Italian drama, fusing the adrenalized rush of competitive motorsport with an emotionally weighty story of solitary resilience.
